title: New Fusion-contained ASM/B-rep reader candidate and profile boundary
scope: Screen newly surfaced open-source ACIS/ASM/B-rep projects for a genuinely new independent semantic route.
Determine whether the candidate directly overlaps libdxfrw DWG AcDs, DXF modeler carriers, or the currently admitted ACIS 217/218 profiles.
Update the implementation plan without adding dependencies, external files, or per-slice validation work.

method.kind: Primary-source repository and project-documentation review with local plan cross-check
method.limitations: ezf3d is observed from mutable GitHub main documentation; this pass did not bind a release, immutable source archive, package, input sample hash, or runtime result. Project-reported internal checks are not independently reproduced.

sources.observed: The README describes an alpha headless reader for Fusion .f3d/.f3z documents. Its documented container is a Zstandard-compressed ZIP with ASM BinaryFile8 streams in Breps.BlobParts/*.smb and *.smbh; one reported sample has ShapeManager 232.4.0.65535. The project reports four real designs, 42 B-rep bodies, topology and edge/curve consistency checks, and comparisons against Fusion-cached display tessellation. It states spline surfaces are not yet trusted/tessellated and modified .f3d writing is a non-goal. The format-unknowns document describes remaining opaque Fusion design records and unsupported routes.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Potential distinct ASM/B-rep parser and validation-method reference. No demonstrated bare-SAB compatibility for ACIS 217/218, no DWG/DXF container support, no AcDs entity-owner/key association, no immutable release or sample hash binding, and no independently authored expected-geometry manifest. Fusion's cached mesh is correlated internal cross-check evidence, not a substitute for pre-authored analytic expectations.

sources.observed: The existing plan scopes these routes to separately documented SAT/SAB profile bands. The newly screened Fusion-contained BinaryFile8 route has not been shown to accept those same byte profiles; project terminology alone does not establish format-profile overlap or independent evidence equivalence.

readiness: Only revisit ezf3d after immutable source/package binding and source-level proof that it accepts the exact extracted bare payload profile.
Separate exact container/payload hash, parser topology, unsupported-record disposition, analytic geometry expectations, and any cached-mesh comparison.
Do not use this route as a DWG AcDs reader, DXF reader, native CAD acceptance result, or evidence for ACIS 217/218 until exact overlap is demonstrated.
If no exact profile overlap exists, mark the candidate NOT_APPLICABLE for that qualification row and continue local work.

repositoryState: Only the parity plan and this research receipt were changed in this pass. The shared checkout is broadly modified; no staging or commit was attempted.
